The '''Garena Premier League 2014 Winter''' was the Winter split of the [[Garena Premier League]] ('''GPL''') 2014 season, held from October 30, 2013, to January 11, 2014. The tournament was hosted in Singapore, with matches played both online and offline at the Garena Stadium, and featured 12 teams from the Southeast Asia and Taiwan–Hong Kong–Macau regions. It marked the first split of the 2014 GPL competitive year. The Group Stage was played in a Double Round Robin format across two groups, with all matches contested as best-of-one. The top four teams from each group advanced to the Playoffs, while the remaining teams were eliminated. The Playoffs followed a Single Elimination bracket, with all matches played as best-of-five. The tournament featured a total prize pool of $200,000 {{Abbr/USD}}. Results from the split awarded GPL points toward seasonal standings.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage:''' ''October 30th - December 4th''
** Teams are divided into two (2) groups of six (6) teams 
** Double Round Robin, {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''1st till 4th place of each group''}} advances to the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''5th and 6th place''}} are eliminated.
* '''Playoffs:''' ''December 4th - January 11th''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
